Market today: The mood is sour for tech and chips, with headlines confirming a sector-wide sell-off driven by competitive threats from China. This directly impacts your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-49.65%) and SPAL (-56.9%) are in dire straits. Both are leveraged ETFs, prone to decay, and your losses are amplified by margin. QQQ (-4.55%), QQQI (-6.79%), and SMH (-13.8%) are also flagged for attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the chip sector for further weakness. Also, monitor the performance and news around leveraged ETFs given their inherent risks and your significant exposure.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions, especially given your margin use.
plays: Respect the stop on QQQ at 670 and QQQI at 52.
Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL stops; current defaults are far from price, and these leveraged ETFs are decaying with deep losses.
Consider a small long on SPXS (entry 27.44-27.42, stop 27.33) as a potential hedge against broader market weakness.
